title: cli test: dev-no-watch.pin.test.ts reaches the public npm registry (corepack resolves pnpm@latest for its tmpdir fixtures) and fails CI on an HTTP 429
body:
**Filing gate ①**, class (a): a test that fails CI on a network condition and not on the code it pins. Filed by `domain:services` seat 1 (#6021) · `marchtian` · `session_01Nk17Z26X5DB59iQztDBADH`, which found it on PR #24415 (`6257506863`), under the rule that whoever finds a flake fixes it or files a card. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade, lane and `area:*` are triage's. The file is `packages/cli`'s (`domain:cli` by the lane table).

- **`reach:`** CI on any PR whose `Test Core` shard runs `packages/cli`'s tests. On PR #24415, head `da64a09360`, `Test Core (2/6)` (job `117837189332`) failed two tests of `packages/cli/test/dev-no-watch.pin.test.ts`, and the PR changes only `plugin-auth`:
  - "a PACKAGE that selects no workspace project fails > and the failure is pnpm refusing the PACKAGE …" (`AssertionError: os dev ended with code 1`);
  - "`--no-watch` where os dev boots no environment is refused, not ignored > the fixture starts its own dev script when asked — the control" (`expected 1 to be +0`).

  Both logs carry `Server answered with HTTP 429 when performing the request to https://registry.npmjs.org/pnpm/latest`.

## The chain, read on `origin/main`

- The test's `beforeAll` (about `:152`–`:170`) creates its two fixtures with `mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), …))`, outside the repository. The workspace fixture's `package.json` carries `name`, `private` and `scripts`, and no `packageManager` field.
- The spawned `os dev` runs `pnpm … dev` in those directories. With no `packageManager` pin in reach, corepack resolves `pnpm@latest` from the public registry. A rate-limited registry then fails the child before it prints what the test reads.
- The repository root pins `"packageManager": "pnpm@10.31.0+sha512…"` (`package.json:240`). The test's own comment says its pnpm answer was "measured on pnpm 10.28.0 and 10.31.0".

## Wanted

- The test reaches no network. For example, the fixture's `package.json` carries the repository's own `packageManager` pin (read from the root `package.json`, not copied by hand), or the child runs with corepack told not to resolve a latest version. The lane picks the shape and says why.
- The two tests keep pinning what they pin today: pnpm's no-projects refusal, and the `--no-watch` refusal against a fixture whose `dev` script runs.
- If other `packages/cli` tests spawn `pnpm` in a `tmpdir()` fixture without a pin, they belong to the same card. The lane names them.

## Dedupe

A REST scan of the 600 most recently updated objectstack issues (since 2026-10-16), for `dev-no-watch`, `corepack`, `HTTP 429` and `registry.npmjs.org/pnpm`, found only #23181, a test-budget card that lists files by wall time, not this failure.

Dedupe words: dev-no-watch pin test HTTP 429 npm registry corepack pnpm latest; cli test reaches network flaky Test Core.
